nodes.description: Reported human alleles remove or truncate the gamma subunit: the founder c.187+1G>T splice-donor variant replaces the last 25 amino acids, which hold the overlapping transducin-binding and catalytic-inhibition regions, with unrelated sequence; a recurrent multi-kilobase deletion removes coding exons 3 and 4; and a frameshift (c.95del) truncates the protein early. ClinGen concludes that the disease mechanism is loss of function. The molecular function bound here is the gamma subunit's own activity as an inhibitor of the PDE6 catalytic core (GO enzyme inhibitor activity, the term GO annotates to PDE6G); its loss paradoxically lowers rather than raises PDE6 activity, as the next node records.
